operations.title: Nima locates the geometric support of degree-four deck data
operations.body: The degree-four geometry is now exact. For four external points with relative-vector Gram G and squared-length vector d, the four equations (ell-r_i)^2=0 force the circumcenter and, away from detG=0, meet iff d^T adj(G)d=0. This is the zero-circumradius Cayley-Menger/Gram discriminant. All five quadruples of the frozen generic rational control have nonzero numerator. Thus degree-four Loewy monomials can become geometric only on extra external support (or a separate Gram-degenerate chart), not as generic loop-base branch strata. Event 1194.
